section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analyses performed in three steps. First, a hypothesized model was investigated in a larger US sample. Second, the model was improved by adding paths based on modification indices. Third, the final model was fit to data from both the US and a smaller non-US sample using multi-group analysis to test fit and compare path coefficients across these two distinct samples.
